Simon & Garfunkel – Sounds of Silence LP | Early Columbia 360 Sound Stereo Pressing | CS 9269 VG+

Up for sale is a beautiful vintage copy of Sounds of Silence by Simon & Garfunkel on Columbia Records.

This is an early U.S. stereo pressing featuring the classic red Columbia “360 Sound” labels and original-era Columbia inner sleeve.

Album Details

  • Artist: Simon & Garfunkel
  • Title: Sounds of Silence
  • Label: Columbia Records
  • Catalog Number: CS 9269
  • Format: Vinyl LP, Stereo
  • Country: U.S.
  • Red “360 Sound” labels

Condition

Vinyl: VG+ / Excellent

Very clean glossy vinyl with minimal visible wear. No major scratches, deep marks, or heavy scuffing visible. A very strong visual copy.

Cover: VG+

Cover presents nicely with light shelf and edge wear consistent with age. No major seam splits.

Inner Sleeve

Includes original Columbia advertising inner sleeve.

Track Highlights

  • The Sounds of Silence
  • I Am a Rock
  • Richard Cory
  • Kathy’s Song
  • April Come She Will

A fantastic collector copy of one of the most iconic folk rock albums of the 1960s.

Ships carefully packed outside the jacket to prevent seam splits.
